messages.subject: For Andrew Snowden | Corporate affairs, sustainability and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Silveira,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Andrew Snowden, President and Chief Executive Officer, and the Corporate Affairs & Sustainability leadership team.

Torex Gold's operating and growth agenda in Mexico places sustainability, government relationships, community confidence and disciplined stakeholder execution at the center of long-term value creation. Those priorities align closely with the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate complex stakeholder and regulatory matters across operating and corporate teams and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of corporate affairs, sustainability, government relations and mining execution might support Torex Gold's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Torex Gold Resources.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
